oromo: Ministiroonni dhimma alaa Qatar fi Oman walitti buiinsa naannichaa hir'isuuf marii bilbilaan taasisaniiru. Gaggeessitoonni kunneen mariifi diplomaasii fayyadamuun akkasumas walii galtee Ameerikaa fi Iraan gidduutti godhame kabajuun barbaachisaa ta'uu ibsaniiru. Dabalataanis, daandii bishaan Hormuz keessatti nagayaan socho'uun mirkanaa'uu qaba jedhaniiru.

title: Trump’s border czar probes possible vetting failures after ICE shooting
english: US border czar Tom Homan is investigating whether vetting procedures failed after an ICE officer with a history of mental health and violence issues was involved in a deadly shooting in Maine. This incident has raised concerns about the rapid hiring and training of new agents tasked with carrying out President Trump’s strict immigration enforcement policies. In response, officials have ordered that body cameras must now be used during all vehicle stops to increase accountability.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የድንበር አስተዳዳሪ ቶም ሆማን፣ በአእምሮ ጤና እና በኃይል አድራጊነት ታሪክ የነበረው የኢሚግሬሽን መኮንን ሜይን ግዛት ውስጥ ገዳይ የተኩስ ልውውጥ ውስጥ መግባቱን ተከትሎ፣ የቅጥር ማጣሪያ ሂደቱ ጉድለት ነበረበት ወይ የሚለውን እያጣሩ ነው። ይህ ክስተት የፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕን ጥብቅ የኢሚግሬሽን ፖሊሲ ለማስፈጸም በችኮላ የተቀጠሩ አዳዲስ መኮንኖች ስልጠና ላይ ጥያቄ አስነስቷል። ለዚህ መፍትሄ እንዲሆን፣ ሁሉም የመኪና ፍተሻዎች በሰውነት ካሜራ እንዲቀረጹ አዲስ መመሪያ ተላልፏል።
oromo: Hogganaan daangaa Ameerikaa Tom Homan, ajajaa ICE tokko kan seenaa rakkoo fayyaa sammuu fi gocha hammeenyaa qabu, yakka ajjeechaa Maine keessatti raawwatamee hordofee qorannoo geggeessaa jira. Dhimmichi kun hojjettoota haaraa duula godaantota ari’uu Trump qindeessuuf ariitiin qacaramanii fi leenji’an irratti shakkii guddaa uumeera. Kana booda akkaataa hojii fooyyessuuf, yeroo konkolaataan dhaabamu hundi kaameraa qaamaa (body camera) fayyadamuun dirqama ta’eera.

title: What’s causing the unprecedented wildfires in Europe?
english: Parts of Western and Southern Europe are currently facing severe and record-breaking wildfires, with France and Spain being particularly affected. The World Health Organization identifies climate change, characterized by frequent heatwaves and rising temperatures, as the primary factor driving these intense fires. In response, local authorities have mobilized large teams of firefighters and requested international support to help contain the crisis.
amharic: በአውሮፓ ምዕራባዊ እና ደቡባዊ ክፍሎች እጅግ አደገኛ እና ታይቶ የማይታወቅ የደን ቃጠሎ ተከስቷል፣ በተለይም ፈረንሳይ እና ስፔን ከፍተኛ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። የዓለም ጤና ድርጅት እንዳለው ከሆነ፣ የአየር ንብረት ለውጥ ያስከተለው ተደጋጋሚ የሙቀት መጠን መጨመር ለዚህ ቃጠሎ መባባስ ዋና ምክንያት ነው። ችግሩን ለመቆጣጠርም አገራቱ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ የእሳት አደጋ መከላከያ ሰራተኞችን በማሰማራት ከአጎራባች አገራት የርዳታ ድጋፍ እየጠየቁ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Kutaa dhihaa fi kibba Awurooppaa keessatti ibidda bosonaa cimaa fi kanaan dura hin mul'anne humnatti jira, keessattuu biyyoonni Faransaayii fi Ispeen miidhaa guddaaf saaxilamaniiru. Dhaabbanni Fayyaa Addunyaa akka ibsetti, jijjiirramni qilleensaa fi hoo'i lafaa dabaluun isaa ibiddoonni kun akka hammatan taasiseera. Rakkoo kana to'achuuf mootummoonni biyyoota kanaa, waraana dhaamsituu ibiddaa kumaatamaan lakkaa'aman bobbaasanii fi biyyoota ollaa irraa gargaarsa gaafachaa jiru.

title: Iran says Strait of Hormuz cannot be used to harm its security
english: Iran's foreign ministry has stated that the Strait of Hormuz will not be allowed to serve as a means for hostile parties to threaten the nation's security. Officials also criticized the United States for not releasing frozen Iranian assets as previously expected. Currently, international mediators like Qatar and Pakistan are working to facilitate communication between the two countries.
amharic: የኢራን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስቴር የሆርሙዝ ስትሬትን የአገሪቱን ደህንነት ለመጉዳት በሚፈልጉ ወገኖች መጠቀም እንደማይቻል አስታውቋል። ባለስልጣናቱ አሜሪካ የታገዱ የኢራን ንብረቶችን ባለመፍታቷ ተችተዋል። በአሁኑ ወቅት እንደ ኳታር እና ፓኪስታን ያሉ አደራዳሪዎች በሁለቱ አገራት መካከል ውይይት እንዲኖር ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው።
oromo: Ministeerri dhimma alaa Iraan akka jedhutti, daandiin galaana Hormuz qaamolee biyya isaa miidhuu barbaadan irraa eegamuu qaba jedheera. Hojjettoonni mootummaa kunneen Ameerikaan qabeenya Iraan kan isheen itti hidhe gadi lakkisuu dhabuu ishee balaaleffataniiru. Yeroo ammaa kanatti, biyyoonni giddu-galeessa ta'an kanneen akka Kaataar fi Paakistaan marii biyyoota lamaan gidduutti godhamuuf carraaqqii gochaa jiru.

title: Trump shares AI-generated images targeting Iran, Kharg Island
english: Former President Donald Trump recently posted artificial intelligence-produced pictures on his social media site. These images illustrate hypothetical scenarios involving an attack on Iran's Kharg oil terminal and the capture of an Iranian oil vessel. The posts have drawn attention due to their depiction of aggressive military actions against Iranian infrastructure.
amharic: ቀድሞ የነበሩት ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በሰው ሰራሽ አስተውሎት (AI) የተፈጠሩ ምስሎችን በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ ገጻቸው ላይ ለጥፈዋል። ምስሎቹ ኢራን ውስጥ የሚገኘው የካርግ የነዳጅ ማጣሪያ ላይ ጥቃት መፈጸሙን እና አንድ የኢራን የነዳጅ መርከብ መያዙን የሚያሳዩ ናቸው። እነዚህ ምስሎች በኢራን መሠረተ ልማቶች ላይ ያነጣጠሩ የጦርነት ሁኔታዎችን የሚስሉ በመሆናቸው ትኩረት ስበዋል።
oromo: Pirezedaantiin duraanii Doonaald Tiraamp suuraalee teeknooloojii 'AI' fayyadamuun tolfaman miidiyaa hawaasummaa isaanii irratti maxxansaniiru. Suuraaleen kun buufata boba'aa Iran kan Kharg jedhamu irratti haleellaan raawwatamuu fi markibni boba'aa Iran tokko qabamuu kan agarsiisanidha. Suuraaleen kun tarkaanfii waraanaa Iran irratti fudhatamuu danda'u fakkeessuudhaan xiyyeeffannoo horataniiru.

title: PM pledges continued support for Ukraine ahead of Zelensky visit
english: Prime Minister Andy Burnham has reaffirmed the UK's strong commitment to Ukraine as he prepares to host President Volodymyr Zelensky for his first official international visit. During the meeting, the UK will share the intellectual property for its 'Stone Cloak' electronic warfare technology to help Ukraine produce it domestically. The leaders will also visit a naval base to engage with Ukrainian troops who are currently participating in maritime training exercises in Britain.
amharic: ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር አንዲ በርንሃም ዩክሬን ለሚገኘው የዩክሬን ፕሬዝዳንት ቮሎዲሚር ዘለንስኪ በዩናይትድ ኪንግደም ለሚያደርጉት የመጀመሪያ ይፋዊ ጉብኝት አቀባበል በማድረግ የእንግሊዝን የጽኑ ድጋፍ አረጋግጠዋል። በጉብኝቱ ወቅት እንግሊዝ የዩክሬን የኤሌክትሮኒክስ ጦርነት አቅምን ለማሳደግ የ'ስቶን ክሎክ' ቴክኖሎጂን በጋራ ለማምረት የሚያስችለውን እውቀት ታካፍላለች። በተጨማሪም መሪዎቹ በብሪታንያ የባህር ኃይል ልምምድ ላይ እየተሳተፉ የሚገኙ የዩክሬን ወታደሮችን ይጎበኛሉ።
oromo: Muummee Ministiraa Andy Burnham gara biyyaa dhufuuf kan qophaa'aa jiru Pireezidaant Volodymyr Zelenskyiif deeggarsa cimaa Ingiliiziin Yukreeniif qabdu irra deebi'anii mirkaneessaniiru. Marii isaanii kana irratti, Ingiliiziin teeknoolojii waraana elektirooniksii 'Stone Cloak' jedhamu Yukreen ofii ishii akka oomishituuf hayyamaafi beekumsa isaa qooduuf karoorfateera. Dabalataanis, murni kun buufata dooniiwwan waraanaa kan daawwatan yoo ta'u, leenjii waraana galaanaa biyyattii keessatti hirmaachaa jiran waraana Yukreen waliin ni wal argu.

title: Israeli government nods to international stabilisation force in Gaza
english: The Israeli government has approved the deployment of an international stabilization force to Gaza as part of a U.S.-backed peace agreement. This force, consisting of personnel from selected partner nations, will operate in areas outside direct Israeli military control to support reconstruction and administrative transitions. Despite this development, violence remains a concern, with reports of ongoing casualties following the initial ceasefire agreement.
amharic: የእስራኤል መንግስት በአሜሪካ ድጋፍ በሚካሄድ የሰላም ስምምነት መሰረት አለም አቀፍ የሰላም አስከባሪ ኃይል ወደ ጋዛ እንዲገባ ፈቅዷል። ይህ ኃይል በእስራኤል ቀጥተኛ ወታደራዊ ቁጥጥር ስር ባልሆኑ አካባቢዎች በመንቀሳቀስ መልሶ ግንባታን እና የአስተዳደር ሽግግርን ይደግፋል። ሆኖም ከተኩስ አቁም ስምምነቱ በኋላም ጥቃቶች እና የሰው ህይወት መጥፋት እንደቀጠለ ተዘግቧል።
oromo: Mootummaan Israa'el walii galtee nagaa Ameerikaan deggeramu keessatti hirmaachuun, humnoonni tasgabbii idil-addunyaa gara Gaazaatti akka seenan hayyameera. Humnoonni kun naannolee waraana Israa'el kallattiin hin to'atne keessatti hojjechaa, deebisanii ijaaruufi sirna bulchiinsaa jijjiiruu keessatti gargaarsa ni kennu. Ta'us, walii galtee dhaabbii waraanaa boodas gochi waraanaafi lubbuu namootaa darbuun itti fufee jira.

title: Palestinians hope international peace force can rebuild Gaza
english: Palestinians in Gaza are optimistic about a proposed international stabilization force entering the region as part of a US-supported ceasefire agreement. Displaced residents believe this mission will be essential for reconstructing their devastated neighborhoods. They hope the intervention will finally allow them to return to their homes after a long period of conflict and displacement.
amharic: በጋዛ የሚገኙ ፍልስጤማውያን በአሜሪካ ድጋፍ በሚደረግ የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት መሰረት አለም አቀፍ የሰላም አስከባሪ ኃይል ወደ አካባቢው እንዲገባ መፈቀዱን ተስፋ ሰጪ ሆኖ አግኝተውታል። ተፈናቃዮች ይህ ኃይል የወደመውን ጋዛን እንደገና ለመገንባት እና ለረጅም ጊዜ ከቤት ንብረታቸው ተፈናቅለው የቆዩ ሰዎች ወደ ቀያቸው እንዲመለሱ እንደሚረዳ ያምናሉ።
oromo: Warra Gaaza keessa jiran kan ta'an Falisxiinonni, waligaltee diinagdee dhaabbii waraanaa kan Ameerikaan deggerame keessatti humnoonni tasgabbeessitoota idil-addunyaa gara naannichaatti akka seenan hayyamamuun isaanii abdii guddaa kenneefii jira. Namoonni buqqa'an humnoonni kun Gaaza kan barbadaaye deebisanii ijaaruuf akkasumas namoota yeroo dheeraaf bakka jireenya isaanii irraa godaananii turan deebisanii qubachiisuuf shoora guddaa akka taphatan abdatu.

title: US and Iran hit pause on strikes for second day
english: The United States and Iran have paused military strikes for two consecutive days following a period of intense conflict. This de-escalation comes as international mediators from nations like Oman, Qatar, and Pakistan work to encourage diplomatic negotiations. While both countries remain cautious, they are currently prioritizing discussions regarding regional maritime security over further military action.
amharic: የአሜሪካ እና የኢራን ወታደራዊ ጥቃቶች ለሁለት ተከታታይ ቀናት መቆማቸው ተሰምቷል። ይህ ውጥረት የመቀነስ እርምጃ የመጣው እንደ ኦማን፣ ኳታር እና ፓኪስታን ያሉ አገራት መካከለኛ በመሆን ድርድር እንዲጀመር ጥረት በማድረጋቸው ነው። ሁለቱም አገራት አሁንም ጥንቃቄ የተሞላበት አቋም ቢይዙም፣ በአሁኑ ሰዓት ወታደራዊ እርምጃ ከመውሰድ ይልቅ በባህር ዳርቻ ደህንነት ጉዳዮች ላይ በዲፕሎማሲያዊ መንገድ ለመወያየት ቅድሚያ ሰጥተዋል።
oromo: Amerikaa fi Iraan waldhabdee waraanaa booda guyyoota lamaaf haleellaa dhaabanii jiru. Tasgabbii kana kan fiede gargaarsa biyyoota akka Omaan, Qatar fi Paakistaan kanneen marii fiiddeebisuuf yaalii taasisanii dha. Biyyoonni lamaanuu of eeggannoo cimaa qabaatanis, ammaaf haleellaa waraanaa irra marii idilee irratti xiyyeeffachaa jiru.

title: Former President Hernandez returns to Honduras after Trump pardon
english: Former Honduran President Juan Orlando Hernandez has returned home following a presidential pardon from Donald Trump, which overturned his 45-year US prison sentence for drug trafficking. Although Trump claimed Hernandez was framed by the previous administration, the former leader still faces separate fraud and money-laundering charges in Honduras. Local human rights activists have expressed concern that his upcoming trial might be compromised and that he will ultimately avoid facing true accountability.
amharic: የሆንዱራስ የቀድሞ ፕሬዝዳንት ሁዋን ኦርላንዶ ሄርናንዴዝ በአሜሪካው ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በተሰጣቸው ይቅርታ ከእስር ተፈተው ወደ ሀገራቸው ተመልሰዋል። ሄርናንዴዝ በአደንዛዥ ዕፅ ዝውውር ወንጀል ተፈርዶባቸው የነበረውን የ45 ዓመት እስራት ትራምፕ እንዲሰረዝ አድርገዋል። ምንም እንኳን ይቅርታ ቢደረግላቸውም፣ በሆንዱራስ በሌሎች የገንዘብ ማጭበርበር ወንጀሎች ክስ ስለሚጠብቃቸው ለፍርድ ይቀርባሉ ተብሎ ይጠበቃል። ይሁን እንጂ የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋቾች ይህ የሆንዱራስ የፍርድ ሂደት አሳማኝ ላይሆን እንደሚችል በመጋለጥ ስጋታቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaantiin duraanii Honduraas Juan Orlando Hernandez, pirezidaantii Ameerikaa Donald Traampin dhiifama waan argataniif hidhaa waggaa 45 kan qoricha sammua namaa hadoochu seeraan alaa gurguruun itti murtaa'ee ture irraa gadhiifamanii gara biyya isaanii deebi'aniiru. Traamp himanni kun mootummaa duraatiin kan qophaa'e akka ta'e dubbatanis, Hernandez amma biyya isaatti himata malaammaltummaa fi qabeenya seeraan alaa dhiheessuun himatamuuf qophaa'aa jiru. Haa ta'u malee, ogeeyyonni mirga namoomaa fi aktivistoonni himanni kun qulqulluun akka hin taane fi Hernandez adabbii tokko malee akka hafan sodaatu.

title: Houthis claim Saudi drone downed over northwestern Yemen
english: Houthi forces in Yemen have reported that they successfully shot down a Saudi Arabian surveillance drone in the northwestern part of the country. The group provided video evidence showing the remains of the destroyed aircraft. This incident occurred shortly after the Houthis announced that they had carried out strikes against Saudi oil infrastructure.
amharic: በየመን የሚንቀሳቀሱት የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በሀገሪቱ ሰሜን ምዕራብ ክፍል የሳውዲ አረቢያን የስለላ ድሮን መትተው መጣላቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ቡድኑ የድሮኑን ስብርባሪ የሚያሳይ ምስል ይፋ ያደረገ ሲሆን፣ ጥቃቱ የሳውዲ የነዳጅ ማጣሪያዎችን ማጥቃታቸውን ካስታወቁ ከአንድ ቀን በኋላ የተፈጸመ ነው።
oromo: Humni Houthi kan Yaman keessatti argamu, xiyyaara malee kan sa'udii arabiya ta'e tokko gara kaaba-dhiha biyyattitti akka buusan beeksisaniiru. Gareen kun ragaa suuraa fi viidiyoo xiyyaarichi gubachuu isaa agarsiisu gadhiiseera. Gochi kun erga gareen Houthi bakkeewwan oomisha boba'aa Sa'udii irratti haleellaa raawwachuu isaanii ibsanii guyyaa tokko booda kan raawwatame dha.

title: Tunisia: Ghannouchi’s daughter says family denied information after his collapse in prison
english: Rached Ghannouchi, the 84-year-old leader of Tunisia's Ennahda party, has been denied family visits and medical updates after collapsing in prison due to extreme heat. His daughter, Soumaya Ghannouchi, reports that authorities have blocked lawyers and family members from seeing him at the hospital where he was reportedly transferred. She has accused the government of endangering his life by detaining a man with serious health conditions in harsh, uncooled prison conditions.
amharic: የቱኒዚያው የኤናህዳ ፓርቲ መሪ ራሺድ ጋኑቺ በእስር ቤት በከፍተኛ ሙቀት ምክንያት ከወደቁ በኋላ ቤተሰቦቻቸው እና ጠበቆቻቸው ስለጤንነታቸው ምንም አይነት መረጃ እንዳያገኙ ተከልክለዋል። ልጃቸው ሱማያ ጋኑቺ እንዳሉት፣ አባታቸው ወደ ሆስፒታል ቢዛወሩም ባለሥልጣናቱ ቤተሰቡ እንዳያያቸው ከልክለዋል። በተለያዩ የጤና እክሎች የሚሰቃዩት የ84 ዓመቱ ጋኑቺ፣ በቂ የአየር ማቀዝቀዣ በሌለበት እስር ቤት መቆየታቸው ለሕይወታቸው ከፍተኛ ስጋት መሆኑን ቤተሰቦቻቸው ይገልጻሉ።
oromo: Hogganaan paartii Ennahda kan Tuuniziyaa Raashiid Ghaannuuchi, mana hidhaa keessatti hoo'a cimaan erga dhukkubsatanii booda maatiin isaanii waa'ee fayyaa isaanii akka hin beekne dhorkamaniiru. Intalli isaanii Suumayyaa Ghaannuuchi akka jettetti, abbaan isaanii gara hospitaalaatti kan geessaman ta'us, abbootiin seeraa fi maatiin akka isaanii hin argine mootummaan dhoorkeera. Ghaannuuchi umrii isaanii 84 fi dhukkuba fayyaa adda addaa qabanirraayyuu, mana hidhaa hoo'a cimaa fi qabbana hin qabne keessa jiraachuun isaanii lubbuu isaanii balaaf saaxilaa akka jiru maatiin isaanii himaniiru.

title: What lies ahead for Iran’s economy as scope of US war grows beyond Hormuz?
english: The ongoing conflict involving Iran and the U.S. has caused significant instability in key maritime trade routes, affecting both global oil markets and Iran's domestic economy. While mediated talks have provided some temporary relief, the U.S. naval blockade continues to threaten Iran's crucial oil export revenues, which are vital for its budget. Consequently, the Iranian government is facing mounting economic pressure, including the difficult prospect of increasing domestic fuel prices amid widespread public frustration.
amharic: በኢራን እና በአሜሪካ መካከል ያለው ግጭት በዓለም አቀፍ የንግድ መስመሮች ላይ ከፍተኛ አለመረጋጋትን በመፍጠር በነዳጅ ገበያው እና በኢራን ኢኮኖሚ ላይ ጫና አሳድሯል። በሽምግልና የተደረጉ ንግግሮች ጊዜያዊ መፍትሄ ቢሰጡም፣ የአሜሪካ የባህር ኃይል ማገጃ የኢራንን ዋና የገቢ ምንጭ የሆነውን የነዳጅ ንግድ አደጋ ላይ ጥሎታል። በዚህም ምክንያት የኢራን መንግስት በአገሪቱ ውስጥ ካለው ከፍተኛ የኑሮ ውድነት እና ህዝባዊ ቅሬታ ጋር ተዳምሮ የነዳጅ ዋጋን የመጨመርን የመሳሰሉ ከባድ ውሳኔዎችን ለመወሰን ተገዷል።
oromo: Gonkii Iran fi US gidduutti itti fufe kun karaalee daldala galaana irraa irratti miidhaa guddaa geessisuun, gabaa boba'aa addunyaa fi diinagdee Iran irratti dhiibbaa uumeera. Mariin giddu-galeessummaan gaggeeffamu furmaata yeroo gabaabaa kenne iyyuu, duulli itti-hiibba galaanaatiin US geggeessitu gurgurtaa boba'aa Iran kan biyyattii itti fayyadamtuuf soda guddaa ta'eera. Kanaafuu, mootummaan Iran rakkoo diinagdee cimaa keessa jiraachuun, mufii ummataa waliin walqabatee gatii boba'aa biyya keessaa dabaluu dabalatee murtoowwan ulfaatoo ta'an fudhachuuf dirqameera.

title: Al-Sharaa outlines Syria’s approach to security with Israel and Lebanon
english: Syrian President Ahmed al-Sharaa announced that his government is actively pursuing a security deal with Israel. Regarding Lebanon, he clarified that Damascus will not send military forces but will instead help the nation address its ongoing challenges. These statements highlight a shift in Syria's regional diplomatic strategy concerning its neighbors.
amharic: የሶሪያው ፕሬዝዳንት አህመድ አል-ሻራ ሶሪያ ከእስራኤል ጋር የፀጥታ ስምምነት ለማድረግ እየሰራች መሆኑን አስታውቀዋል። በሊባኖስ ጉዳይ ላይም ወታደራዊ ጣልቃ ገብነት እንደማያደርጉ በመግለጽ፣ በምትኩ አገሪቱ ካለችበት ቀውስ እንድትወጣ ድጋፍ እንደሚያደርጉ ገልጸዋል። ይህ መግለጫ የሶሪያን የክልላዊ ዲፕሎማሲ አቅጣጫ የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Pireezidaantiin Sooriyaa Ahimad Al-Sharaa mootummaan isaanii Israaʼel waliin waliigaltee nageenyaa gochuuf hojjechaa akka jiru ibsan. Dhimma Libaanoos irrattis, biyyi isaanii humna waraanaa akka hin ergine fi rakkoo biyyattiin keessa jirtu akka furattu gargaarsa akka gootan beeksisan. Ibsi kun jijjiirama siyaasaa alaa Sooriyaa kan agarsiisuudha.

title: 46 people rescued from sunken ship in South China Sea
english: A total of 46 individuals were safely recovered after their Vietnamese boat went down in the South China Sea. Rescue teams successfully pulled the passengers from the water following the maritime accident. Authorities are managing the situation as the survivors receive necessary assistance.
amharic: በደቡብ ቻይና ባህር ውስጥ የቪየትናም መርከብ በመስጠሟ 46 ሰዎች በህይወት ተረፈዋል። የነፍስ አድን ሰራተኞች አደጋው በደረሰበት አካባቢ በመገኘት ተሳፋሪዎቹን ከውሃ ውስጥ ማውጣት ችለዋል። የተረፉት ሰዎች አስፈላጊውን ድጋፍ እያገኙ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Dooniin Viyeetnaam tokko garba Chaayinaa kibbaatti gadi lixeen wal qabatee, namoonni 46 lubbuun oorfamaniiru. Gareen gargaarsa hatattamaa balaa kana booda namoota bishaan keessa turan kana baasuu danda'aniiru. Namootni lubbuun hafan kunis gargaarsa barbaachisu argachaa jiru.

title: Cuban president accuses US of genocide, seeking takeover
english: Cuban President Miguel Diaz-Canel has publicly accused the United States of committing genocide and attempting to take control of his country. This follows an ongoing oil embargo and severe economic sanctions imposed by Washington, which have triggered widespread power outages and critical resource shortages across the island. The Cuban leader claims these aggressive measures are intended to stifle the nation’s economy and force a political takeover.
amharic: የኩባው ፕሬዚዳንት ሚጌል ዲያዝ-ካኔል አሜሪካ በሀገራቸው ላይ የዘር ማጥፋት ወንጀል እየፈጸመች እና አገሪቱን ለመቆጣጠር እየሞከረች ነው ሲሉ ከሰሱ። ይህ የተባለው ዋሽንግተን በጣለችው የነዳጅ ማዕቀብ እና በሌሎች የኢኮኖሚ ማዕቀቦች ሳቢያ በኩባ ውስጥ የከፋ የኤሌክትሪክ መቆራረጥ እና የዕለት ተዕለት ኑሮ እጥረት መፈጠሩን ተከትሎ ነው። የኩባ መሪ እንደገለጹት እነዚህ ጫናዎች የሀገሪቱን ኢኮኖሚ በማዳከም በሕዝቡ ላይ የፖለቲካ ቁጥጥር ለማድረግ የሚደረግ ጥረት ነው።
oromo: Pireezidaantiin Kuubaa Miigeel Diyaaz-Kaaneel, Ameerikaan biyya isaa irratti sanyii balleessuu raawwachaa fi biyyattii to'achuuf yaalaa jirti jechuun himatan. Himannaan kun kan dhufe erga Waashingitan daangaa boba'aa fi adabbii dinagdee cimaa biyyattii irratti kaastee booda, ergaa sanaan walqabatee rakkoon elektirikii fi hir'inni meeshaalee barbaachisoo ta'an biyyattii keessatti babal'achuu isaatiin walqabata. Hogganaan Kuubaa akka jedhanitti, tarkaanfiiwwan kun kanneen dinagdee biyyattii laamsheessuun uummata gidirsuu fi biyyattii to'annoo isaanii jala galchuuf karoorfaman dha.

title: Netanyahu vows to go to New York City despite ICC arrest warrant, Mamdani
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has announced his plan to speak at the United Nations in New York City, openly defying an arrest warrant issued by the International Criminal Court. During a television interview, he criticized New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani for his pro-Palestinian stance and suggestions that the Prime Minister should be arrested upon arrival. Despite Netanyahu’s accusations against the mayor, recent polling suggests that a significant number of American Jewish adults hold a more favorable view of Mamdani than they do of Netanyahu.
amharic: የእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ በዓለም አቀፍ የወንጀለኞች ፍርድ ቤት የወጣባቸውን የእስር ትእዛዝ ችላ በማለት በኒውዮርክ በሚገኘው የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት ዋና መስሪያ ቤት ንግግር እንደሚያደርጉ አስታውቀዋል። ኔታንያሁ ለኒውዮርክ ከንቲባ ዞህራን ማምዳኒ በሰነዘሩት ትችት፣ ከንቲባው እሱን በመቃወም ጥላቻን እያነሳሱ ነው ሲሉ ከሰዋል። ሆኖም በቅርቡ የተደረጉ ጥናቶች እንደሚያሳዩት፣ አሜሪካ ውስጥ የሚኖሩ ብዙ አይሁዳውያን ስለ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሩ ካላቸው አስተያየት ይልቅ ስለ ከንቲባው ያላቸው አመለካከት በጎ እንደሆነ ያመለክታል።
oromo: Muummee ministira Israa'el Benyaamin Netanyaahuun, ajaja hidhaa Mana Murtii Yakka Addunyaa irraa isaan irratti darbe osoo hin hubatin, magaala Niiw Yoorkitti argamuun waldaa mootummoota gamtoomaniitti haasawa akka godhan beeksisaniiru. Netanyaahuun kantiibaa magaala Niiw Yoorki Zooraan Maamdaanii, deeggarsa isaanii kan Falasxiinootaaf qaban fi yaada isaan ajaja hidhaa kana deggeran irratti hundaauun, kantiibichi jibba babal'isaa jiru jechuun qeequ. Ta'us, qorannoon dhiheenya kana taasifame akka agarsiisutti, namoonni Yuudii Ameerikaa keessa jiraatan baay'een isaanii Netanyaahuu caalaatti kantiibaa Zooraan Maamdaanii akka deggeran ifa godheera.

title: Syrian president says security deal with Israel would not compromise Golan rights
english: Syrian President Ahmed al-Sharaa announced that a potential security agreement with Israel could lead to lasting peace while maintaining Syria's claim over the Golan Heights. He emphasized that any such deal should involve international cooperation. Additionally, the president stated that Syria has secured its borders against regional threats and will not pursue military action in Lebanon, choosing instead to support that nation's stability.
amharic: የሶሪያው ፕሬዝዳንት አህመድ አል-ሻራ ከእስራኤል ጋር የሚደረግ የፀጥታ ስምምነት የጎላን ሃይትስን መብት ሳይነካ ዘላቂ ሰላምን ሊያመጣ እንደሚችል ገልጸዋል። ስምምነቱም በተለያዩ ሀገራት ተሳትፎ እንዲካሄድ ፍላጎታቸውን አሳይተዋል። ከዚህ በተጨማሪም ፕሬዝዳንቱ የሶሪያ ድንበሮች ደህንነት የተጠበቀ መሆኑን እና በሊባኖስ ላይ ወታደራዊ ጣልቃ ገብነት እንደማያደርጉ በመግለጽ ለሀገሪቱ መረጋጋት ድጋፍ እንደሚያደርጉ አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaantiin Suuriyaa Ahimad Al-Sharaa akka jedhanitti, waliigalteen nageenyaa Israa'el waliin ta'u, mirga Suuriyaan Godina Goolan irratti qabdu osoo hin tuqin nagaa buusuu danda'a. Waliigaltee kana keessatti biyyoonni hedduun hirmaachuu akka qabanis ibsaniiru. Dabalataanis, Suuriyaan daangaa ishee eeggachuu fi Lubaanaan keessaatti tarkaanfii waraanaa fudhachuu akka hin barbaanne ibsuun, qooda kanaa tasgabbii biyyattii deggaruu akka filatan beeksisaniiru.

title: Berlin Pride attack suspect shot and killed during police operation
english: A 21-year-old suspect named Abdul Ballout was shot and killed by German police after attacking officers with a knife during a manhunt. Authorities believe he was responsible for a terror attack at a Berlin Pride event that involved driving a van into a crowd and a subsequent stabbing, resulting in one death and many injuries. The suspect had a documented history of radicalization and prior criminal offenses, leading officials to raise the national terror threat level.
amharic: አብዱል ባሉት የተባለ የ21 ዓመት ተጠርጣሪ በበርሊን ግብረ-ሰዶማውያን ሰልፍ ላይ ጥቃት በማድረሱ የተፈለገ ሲሆን፣ ፖሊስ ባደረገው ኦፕሬሽን ወቅት በቢላዋ ሊወጋቸው ሲሞክር በጥይት ተመትቶ ተገድሏል። ተጠርጣሪው መኪና ወደ ሰው በመንዳት እና ቢላዋ በመጠቀም ያደረሰው ጥቃት የአንድ ሰው ህይወት ሲያልፍ ሌሎች በርካቶች እንዲቆስሉ ምክንያት ሆኗል። ባለስልጣናት ይህንን ጥቃት 'እስላማዊ የሽብር ጥቃት' ሲሉ የገለጹት ሲሆን፣ የተጠርጣሪው የቀድሞ የረዲካላይዜሽን እና የወንጀል ታሪክ ግምት ውስጥ በማስገባት የአገሪቱን የጸጥታ ስጋት ደረጃ ከፍ አድርገዋል።
oromo: Abdul Baalluut jedhamuun kan himatame dargaggeessi waggaa 21, erga guyyaa kabaja Berlin Pride irratti nama ajjeeseefi miidhe booda poolisiin adamsamaa ture. Poolisiin yeroo isa qabuuf yaale, mummuchaa waraanee itti dhufnaan rasaasaan rukutee ajjeeseera. Namni kun konkolaataa ummata keessatti oofuunifi waraanaan miidhaa cimaa geessiseen, dubartiin tokko yeroo duutu, namoonni 29 ol immoo miidhamaniiru. Mootummaan Jarmanii gochi kun 'shororkeessummaa islaamaa' ta'uu ibsuun, seenaa yakkaafi harka fuudha inni duraan qabu hordofuun eeggannoo nageenyaa biyyattii ol kaasaniiru.

title: Israeli settlers burn two mosques in occupied West Bank
english: Israeli settlers recently set fire to two mosques in the occupied West Bank, resulting in major structural damage and the presence of hateful graffiti. According to Palestinian authorities, these incidents are part of a broader pattern, with at least 45 mosques targeted by settlers since the beginning of 2025. This ongoing violence continues to heighten tensions throughout the region.
amharic: የእስራኤል ሰፈራ ነዋሪዎች በተያዘው ዌስት ባንክ ውስጥ በሚገኙ ሁለት መስጊዶች ላይ እሳት በማያያዝ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት አድርሰዋል። የፍልስጤም ባለስልጣናት እንደገለጹት፣ ከ2025 መጀመሪያ አንስቶ ቢያንስ 45 መስጊዶች በእነዚህ ቡድኖች ጥቃት ደርሶባቸዋል። ይህ ድርጊት በክልሉ ያለውን ውጥረት የበለጠ አባብሶታል።
oromo: Warra Israa'el irraa dhufan kanneen daangaa irra qubatan, godina Wasti Baank keessatti masjiidota lama irratti ibidda qabsiisuun miidhaa guddaa geessisaniiru. Abbootiin taayitaa Falasxiin akka ibsanitti, bara 2025 jalqabee masjiidonni 45 ol ta'an haleellaa akkanaa kana keessatti kan manca'an ykn gubatan ta'uun beekameera. Gochi kun naannichatti walitti bu'iinsa uumame jiru caalaatti hammeesseera.

title: Romania summons Russian envoy as it shoots down third intruding drone
english: Romania has called in the Russian ambassador after successfully shooting down three separate drones that violated its airspace over three consecutive days. The incidents have raised significant alarms regarding the potential for the Russia-Ukraine conflict to spill over into neighboring NATO territory. Officials in Bucharest and the military alliance have condemned these repeated incursions as unacceptable and potentially provocative actions.
amharic: ሮማኒያ በተከታታይ ሶስት ቀናት ውስጥ የአገሯን የአየር ክልል ጥሰው የገቡ ሶስት ሰው አልባ አውሮፕላኖችን (ድሮኖች) መትታ መጣሏን ተከትሎ የሩሲያን አምባሳደር ጠርታ አነጋገረች። እነዚህ ተደጋጋሚ ድርጊቶች የሩሲያ እና ዩክሬን ጦርነት ወደ ጎረቤት የኔቶ አባል አገራት ሊስፋፋ ይችላል የሚል ከፍተኛ ስጋት ፈጥረዋል። የቡካሬስት ባለስልጣናት እና የኔቶ ወታደራዊ ህብረት እነዚህን ተደጋጋሚ የአየር ክልል ጥሰቶች እንደ ተቀባይነት የሌለው እና አደገኛ ድርጊት አውግዘዋቸዋል።
oromo: Roomaaniyaan guyyoota sadiif walitti aansee qilleensa ishee keessa darbuudhaan daangaa cabsan xiyyoota nama hin feene sadii erga rukuttee buustee booda, ambaasaaddara Raashiyaa waamsifteetti. Gochi kun waraanni Raashiyaa fi Yuukreen biyyoota ollaa kanneen Neetoo (NATO) keessatti argamanitti ce'uu danda'a jedhanii yaaddoo uumeera. Bulchiinsi Roomaaniyaa fi dhaabbatni waraanaa NATO gochawwan irra deddeebi'anii raawwataman kana akka fudhatama hin qabne fi akka gocha yaaddoo qabuutti balaaleffataniiru.

title: Al-Sharaa praises Trump’s decision to remove Syria from terrorism list
english: Syrian President Ahmed al-Sharaa has expressed support for Donald Trump's move to remove Syria from the American list of state sponsors of terrorism. He argued that this designation is currently obsolete and hinders the nation's economic restoration efforts. Al-Sharaa emphasized that lifting sanctions will not be fully effective for Syria's recovery unless this specific terrorist classification is also dropped.
amharic: የሶሪያው ፕሬዚዳንት አህመድ አል-ሻራ ሶሪያ ከአሜሪካ የአሸባሪዎች መዝገብ እንድትወጣ ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የወሰዱትን ውሳኔ አድንቀዋል። አሁን ያለው ስያሜ ጊዜ ያለፈበት እንደሆነና የአገሪቱን ኢኮኖሚያዊ መልሶ ማቋቋም ስራ እያስተጓጎለ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። እንደ አል-ሻራ ገለጻ፣ አገሪቱ ከኢኮኖሚ ማዕቀቦች ነጻ ብትሆንም የሽብርተኝነት መዝገቡ ካልተሰረዘ በስተቀር ሙሉ ለውጥ ለማምጣት አስቸጋሪ ነው።
oromo: Pireezidaantii Siiriyaa Ahimad Al-Sharaa murtee Doonaald Tiraamp Siiriyaa tarree biyyoota shororkeessitoota gargaaran irraa kaasuu isaanii dinqisiifataniiru. Maqaan kun yeroon isaa kan darbeefi haala dinagdee biyyattii deebisanii ijaaruu irratti gufuu akka ta'e dubbataniiru. Al-Sharaa akka jedhanitti, ergiin diinagdee oggaa ka'u, maqaan shororkeessummaa kun yoo hin kaane biyyattiin guddina barbaadamu galmeessisuu hin dandeessu.

title: Israeli forces raid Qalandiya refugee camp, injure Palestinian
english: Israeli military forces conducted a raid on the Qalandiya refugee camp, located near East Jerusalem. During the operation, soldiers utilized live ammunition, tear gas, and stun grenades, resulting in the injury of at least one Palestinian. The troops also disrupted local traffic by stopping vehicles as they moved through the area.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በምስራቅ እየሩሳሌም አቅራቢያ በሚገኘው የቃላንዲያ የስደተኞች መጠለያ ካምፕ ላይ ወረራ ፈጽመዋል። በኦፕሬሽኑ ወቅት ወታደሮቹ ጥይቶችን፣ እንባ ጋዝ እና ደንዛዛ ቦንቦችን በመጠቀማቸው ቢያንስ አንድ ፍልስጤማዊ ቆስሏል። ወታደሮቹ በካምፑ ሲዘዋወሩ የተሽከርካሪዎችን እንቅስቃሴም አግደው ነበር።
oromo: Humnoonni Israa'el qubata baqattootaa Qalandiyaa kan Yerusaalem Bahaa biratti argamu irratti duula gaggeessaniiru. Duula kanaan walqabatee humnoonni kun dhukaasa qawwee, gaazii imimmaansuu fi meeshaa nama burjaajessu fayyadamuu isaanii fi kana irraa kan ka'e namni Palastiin tokko madaa'uu gabaasameera. Humnoonni kunis naannichatti yeroo socho'anitti konkolaattota dhaabsisuun sochii uummataa gufachiisaniiru.

title: Israeli settlers establish three new outposts in West Bank
english: Israeli settlers recently set up three new outposts on privately owned Palestinian land in various areas of the West Bank. This move follows a reported increase in land seizures and violent incidents in these regions. Official reports indicate that dozens of such outposts have been established throughout the first half of 2026 across multiple governorates.
amharic: የእስራኤል ሰፈራ ሰሪዎች በምዕራብ ባንክ በሚገኙ በፓለስቲናውያን ባለቤትነት ስር ባሉ መሬቶች ላይ ሶስት አዳዲስ ሰፈራዎችን መመስረታቸው ተዘግቧል። ይህ ድርጊት በክልሉ እየተባባሰ በመጣው የመሬት ወረራ እና የጥቃት ክስተቶች መካከል የተከናወነ ነው። መረጃዎች እንደሚያመለክቱት እ.ኤ.አ በ2026 የመጀመሪያዎቹ ስድስት ወራት ብቻ በደርዘን የሚቆጠሩ ተመሳሳይ ህገ-ወጥ ሰፈራዎች በተለያዩ የክልሉ አካባቢዎች ተመስርተዋል።
oromo: Qotee bultoonni Israa'el naannoo Daangaa Dhihaa keessatti lafa abbootii qabeenyaa Falasxiin ta'e irratti buufataalee haarawa sadii dhaabaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun kutaalee kana keessatti babal'achaa jiruufi walitti bu'iinsi lafaa dabalaa dhufe hordofee kan dhufe dha. Gabaasni akka agarsiisutti, bara 2026 walakkaa isa duraa keessatti qofa buufataaleen gosa kanaa darzan baay'een naannoolee gara garaa keessatti dhaabamaniiru.

title: Qatari PM, UAE national security adviser discuss peace efforts
english: The Prime Minister of Qatar and the National Security Adviser of the UAE recently held a phone call to discuss strengthening their relationship and addressing regional stability. The two officials focused on diplomatic strategies to lower tensions, emphasizing the need for open communication and safe maritime travel. Additionally, they highlighted the importance of adhering to international agreements to help maintain long-term peace across the Middle East.
amharic: የኳታር ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር እና የተባበሩት አረብ ኢምሬቶች የብሔራዊ ደህንነት አማካሪ በስልክ ውይይት በማድረግ በሁለቱ ሀገራት ግንኙነት እና በክልሉ ወቅታዊ ጉዳዮች ላይ ተወያይተዋል። ባለስልጣናቱ በክልሉ ያለውን ውጥረት ለመቀነስ እና የባህር ላይ ደህንነትን ለማረጋገጥ የሚረዱ ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ጥረቶችን መክረዋል። በተጨማሪም በክልሉ ዘላቂ ሰላም እንዲሰፍን ውይይት ማድረግ እና ዓለም አቀፍ ስምምነቶችን ማክበር አስፈላጊ መሆኑን አጽንኦት ሰጥተዋል።
oromo: Mummichi Ministeeraa Katar fi gorsaan nageenya biyyoolessaa UAE dhimmoota hariiroo biyyoota lamaanii fi tasgabbii naannichaa irratti bilbilan mari’ataniiru. Itti gaafatamtoonni kunneen walitti bu’iinsa naannichaa gadi xiqqessuufi tasgabbii daandii galaanaarratti argamu mirkaneessuuf carraaqqii diippiloomaasii irratti xiyyeeffataniiru. Dabalataanis, naannichatti nagaan dhaabbataa akka dhufuuf mariin xiyyeeffannoo argachuu fi waliigaltee idil-addunyaa kabajuun murteessaa ta’uu ibsaniiru.

title: Berlin police shoot dead suspect in car ramming attack on Pride event
english: German police fatally shot 21-year-old Abdul Ballout after he attacked officers with a knife in Berlin. Ballout was the primary suspect in a car-ramming attack during a Pride event that resulted in one death and 29 injuries. Authorities have classified the incident as an act of Islamic terrorism following a day-long manhunt.
amharic: የጀርመን ፖሊስ በበርሊን በቢላዋ በመታገዝ ጥቃት ለማድረስ የሞከረውን አብዱል ባሉት የተባለውን ተጠርጣሪ በጥይት ገድሎታል። ግለሰቡ በቅርቡ በበርሊን በተካሄደው የግብረሰዶማውያን ሰልፍ (Pride event) ላይ መኪና በመንዳት አንድ ሰው እንዲሞትና 29 ሰዎች እንዲቆስሉ በማድረጉ ዋና ተጠርጣሪ ነበር። ባለስልጣናት ይህንን ድርጊት የእስላማዊ ሽብር ጥቃት እንደሆነ አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Poolisiin Jarmanii namicha Abdool Balluut jedhamu kan umriin isaa 21 ta'e, erga bakka isaa argatanii booda hidhataan isaa madaa'ee du'eera. Namichi kun guyyaa kaleessaa magaala Berlinitti sagantaa kabaja mirgaa (Pride event) irratti konkolaataa oofee namoota hedduu irratti erga rurrukutee booda, namni tokko du'ee 29 immoo madaa'anii turan. Aangeyyonni mootummaa gochi kun shoroorkeessummaa Islaamummaa waliin kan walqabatu akka ta'e ibsaniiru.

title: Israel launches military incursion into Syria amid UN condemnation
english: Israeli forces have entered southwestern Syria, setting up checkpoints and warning residents, which marks a significant escalation in ongoing border tensions. UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres strongly condemned these actions, labeling the violation of Syria's sovereignty as unacceptable and a breach of previous agreements. While the Syrian government is calling for a withdrawal, officials in Damascus are simultaneously pursuing negotiations for a potential security deal to restore regional stability.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደሮች ወደ ደቡብ ምዕራብ ሶሪያ በመግባት የፍተሻ ጣቢያዎችን በመዘርጋት በአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች ላይ ማስጠንቀቂያ ሰጥተዋል። የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት ዋና ጸሃፊ አንቶኒዮ ጉቴሬዝ የእስራኤልን ድርጊት የሶሪያን ሉዓላዊነት የጣሰ እና ተቀባይነት የሌለው በማለት አውግዘውታል። የሶሪያ መንግስት ወታደሮቹ እንዲወጡ ቢጠይቅም፣ በሌላ በኩል ደግሞ ለቀጣናው ሰላም ሲባል ከእስራኤል ጋር የጸጥታ ስምምነት ለማድረግ ድርድር እያደረገ ነው።
oromo: Humnoonni Israa'el gara kibba-dhiha Suuriyaatti seenuun, iddoo sakatta'iinsaa dhaabuufi uummata akeekkachiisuun waldhabdee daangaa kana hamma hammaatanii jiru. Barreessaan Olaanaan Dhaabbata Mootummoota Gamtoomanii Antooniyoo Guuteereez, gochi Israa'el kun kabaja biyyattii cabsinee fi fudhatama kan hin qabne ta'uu balaaleeffataniiru. Mootummaan Suuriyaa waraanni Israa'el akka ba'u gaafatus, gamasaatiin nageenya naannichaa mirkaneessuuf Israa'el waliin marii nagaa taasisaa jiru.

title: ‘Freeze the conflict’: Drones slow Kazakh oil flow amid Russia-Ukraine war
english: Kazakhstan has reduced its oil production following drone strikes on a major export terminal in Russia, which has disrupted energy supplies to international markets. In response to these economic pressures, President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev has publicly urged for a freeze in the Russia-Ukraine war. He suggested returning to peace talks to end the hostilities that are negatively affecting his nation's vital oil infrastructure.
amharic: ሩሲያ ውስጥ በሚገኝ ዋና የነዳጅ ማስተላለፊያ ተርሚናል ላይ በደረሰ የድሮን ጥቃት ምክንያት ካዛኪስታን የነዳጅ ምርቷን ቀንሳለች። ይህ ክስተት በዓለም አቀፍ የነዳጅ ገበያ ላይ ተጽዕኖ መፍጠሩን ተከትሎ፣ የካዛኪስታን ፕሬዝዳንት ካሲም-ጆማርት ቶካዬቭ የሩሲያ እና ዩክሬን ጦርነት እንዲቆም ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። ፕሬዝዳንቱ የሀገራቸውን የኢኮኖሚ ደህንነት ለመጠበቅ ሲባል ግጭቱን በድርድር መፍታት እንደሚያስፈልግ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Kaazaakhistaan buufata boba'aa guddaa Raashiyaa keessatti argamu irratti weerara xiyyaara maleeyyuun (drone) erga mudatee booda oomisha boba'aa ishee hir'ifteetti. Rakkoon kun gabaa boba'aa addunyaa irratti dhiibbaa waan uumeef, pirezidaantiin Kaazaakhistaan Kaasim-Joomart Tookaayeev waraanni Raashiyaa fi Yuukreen akka dhaabatu gaafataniiru. Pirezidaantichi dinagdee biyya isaanii miidhaa jiru kana tasgabbeessuuf, waraana kana dhaabuun mariitti deebi'uun barbaachisaa ta'uu ibsaniiru.

title: Israel obstructing takeover of pilot zones in Lebanon’s south: Military
english: The Lebanese military has accused Israel of violating a recent US-backed agreement by continuing military operations in southern Lebanon. Israeli shelling and destructive activities in designated pilot villages are preventing Lebanese troops from fully securing these areas and allowing civilians to return home. Despite the planned phased withdrawal of Israeli forces, ongoing combat operations remain a major obstacle to the stabilization of the region.
amharic: የሊባኖስ ወታደራዊ ኃይል እስራኤል በቅርቡ በአሜሪካ ድጋፍ የተደረሰውን ስምምነት በመጣስ በደቡብ ሊባኖስ ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴዋን እንደቀጠለች ከሷል። እስራኤል በተመረጡ መንደሮች ላይ የምታደርሰው የቦምብ ድብደባ እና ጥፋት የሊባኖስ ጦር አካባቢዎቹን ተረክቦ ደህንነትን ለማስጠበቅ እንዲሁም ተፈናቃዮች ወደ ቤታቸው ለመመለስ እንዳይችሉ እንቅፋት ሆኗል። ምንም እንኳን የእስራኤል ኃይሎች ቀስ በቀስ ለመውጣት ቢስማሙም፣ ቀጣይነት ያለው ጥቃት የሰላም ሂደቱን አስቸጋሪ አድርጎታል።
oromo: Raayyaan ittisa biyya Libnaan, Israa'el waliigaltee Ameerikaan deggerame cabsuun kibba Libnaan keessatti hojii waraanaa itti fufuu ishee himateera. Israa'el ganda filataman keessatti dhukaasa banuu fi miidhaa geessisuun ishee, waraanni Libnaan bakkeewwan kana to'achuun nageenya mirkaneessuu fi namoonni buqqa'an gara manaa isaanii akka deebi'an gufuu ta'eera. Waraanni Israa'el gaggabinaan gadi lakkisee ba'uuf kan karoorfame ta'us, haleellaan yeroo ammaa gaggeeffamaa jiru tasgabbii naannichaa irratti ciniinsuu cimaa ta'eera.

title: Heatwave drives major wildfires across North Africa
english: Severe heatwaves and powerful winds are currently causing large-scale wildfires to spread across Algeria, Morocco, and Tunisia. These fires are damaging vital forests and agricultural land while posing a serious threat to local residential areas. Tunisia has requested international assistance to provide specialized aircraft to help contain the growing blazes.
amharic: በሰሜን አፍሪካ ሀገራት በቱኒዚያ፣ በአልጄሪያ እና በሞሮኮ ከፍተኛ የሙቀት መጠንና ኃይለኛ ነፋስ ምክንያት ሰደድ እሳቶች እየተቀጣጠሉ ይገኛሉ። እነዚህ የእሳት አደጋዎች ደኖችንና የእርሻ መሬቶችን እያወደሙ ከመሆኑም በላይ በአቅራቢያ የሚኖሩ ማህበረሰቦችን ህይወት አደጋ ላይ ጥለዋል። ቱኒዚያም እየተስፋፋ ያለውን እሳት ለመቆጣጠር ዓለም አቀፍ የአየር ላይ ድጋፍ ጠይቃለች።
oromo: Afrikaa Kaabaa keessatti, biyyoota akka Tuuniiziyaa, Aljeeriyaa fi Morookoo keessatti ho'i cimaa fi qilleensi humna qabu ibidda bosonaa babal'isaa jira. Ibidni kun bosonaa fi lafa qonnaa gubuu malees, naannoo jireenyaa namootaatti waan dhiyaateef soda guddaa uumeera. Tuuniiziyaan ibidda kana to'achuuf gargaarsa xiyyaaraa biyyoota alaa gaafatteetti.

title: Darfur: Weaponising Identity
english: A recent documentary investigates the ongoing crisis in Darfur, highlighting how land disputes, environmental pressures, and government neglect have escalated into mass violence. It explains how authorities fueled ethnic divisions by arming specific militias and utilizing racist rhetoric to target civilian populations. The film analyzes the transition of these conflicts into crimes against humanity and genocide, while questioning the effectiveness of global justice efforts for the victims.
amharic: የቅርብ ጊዜ ዘጋቢ ፊልም በዳርፉር እየተካሄደ ያለውን ቀውስ በመመርመር፣ የመሬት ይገባኛል ጥያቄ፣ የአካባቢ ጫና እና የመንግስት ቸልተኝነት ወደ መጠነ ሰፊ ግጭት እንዴት እንዳደጉ ያብራራል። ባለስልጣናት ታጣቂዎችን በማስታጠቅ እና ዘረኛ የንግግር ዘይቤዎችን በመጠቀም በጎሳዎች መካከል መከፋፈልን እንዴት እንደፈጠሩ ዘገባው ያሳያል። ፊልሙ እነዚህ ግጭቶች ወደ የሰው ልጆች ላይ የሚፈጸሙ ወንጀሎች እና የዘር ማጥፋት ድርጊት እንዴት እንደተሸጋገሩ በመተንተን፣ ለተጎጂዎች የተሰጠው ፍትህ አጥጋቢ መሆን አለመሆኑን ይጠይቃል።
oromo: Sanadni haaraa tokko rakkoo Darfuur keessatti mul'atuu fi waldhabdee lafaa, dhiibbaa naannoo akkasumas tuffii mootummaan uumame gara walitti bu'iinsa guddaatti jijjiiramuu isaa qorata. Mootummaan garee hidhattootaa hidhachiisuun fi jechoota sanyummaa babal'isuun akkaataa gosaa fi gosa gidduutti walitti bu'iinsa uume ibsa. Fiilmichii, gochi kun gara yakka namoomaa fi sanyii balleessuutti jijjiiramuu isaa kan qoratu yoo ta'u, haqni miidhamtootaaf kenname gahaa ta'uu isaas gaaffii keessa galcha.

title: Typhoon Noul batters Southeast China
english: Typhoon Noul has struck the coastal areas of southern China, bringing intense winds and significant flooding. While this is the twelfth typhoon of the year, it is currently considered the most powerful to make landfall. Heavy rains are projected to persist in the region until at least Tuesday.
amharic: ቲፎን ናውል የቻይናን ደቡባዊ የባህር ጠረፍ አካባቢዎች በኃይለኛ ንፋስ እና በጎርፍ አጥለቅልቋል። ይህ አውሎ ንፋስ ዘንድሮ በቻይና የተከሰተው አስራ ሁለተኛው ቢሆንም፣ እስካሁን ከነበሩት ሁሉ በጣም ኃይለኛው ነው። ከፍተኛ ዝናብም እስከ ማክሰኞ ድረስ እንደሚቀጥል ተገምቷል።
oromo: Obomboleettiin Noul jedhamu gammoojjii kibba Chaayinaa keessatti qilleensa cimaa fi lolaa guddaadhaan miidhaa geessiseera. Obomboleettiin kun bara kana keessatti biyyattii kan rukute isa kudha lammaffaa ta’us, ammaaf isa hunda caalaa jabaa dha. Roobni cimaan kun hamma guyyaa Kibxataatti itti fufa jedhamee eegama.

title: Israeli security cabinet approves international force entering Gaza beyond Israeli-occupied areas
english: The Israeli security cabinet has given the green light for an international peacekeeping force to be deployed in specific sections of Gaza. This initiative is a component of a broader strategy supported by the United States to manage the territory. These foreign troops will be permitted to operate only in areas currently outside of Israeli military control.
amharic: የእስራኤል የፀጥታ ካቢኔ ዓለም አቀፍ የሰላም አስከባሪ ኃይል በጋዛ የተወሰኑ አካባቢዎች እንዲሰማራ ፈቃድ ሰጥቷል። ይህ ውሳኔ በአሜሪካ ድጋፍ የሚደረግለት አጠቃላይ የጋዛ አስተዳደር ዕቅድ አካል ነው። እነዚህ ዓለም አቀፍ ኃይሎች የሚንቀሳቀሱት እስራኤል በቀጥታ ቁጥጥር በማታደርግባቸው የጋዛ ክፍሎች ብቻ ይሆናል።
oromo: Mootummaan Israa'el humnoonni naga-eegumsaa idil-addunyaa naannawwaa Gaaza keessatti bakka isheen hin to'anne tokko tokkotti akka bobba'an hayyameera. Tarkaanfiin kun karoora biyyoonni Gamtoomanii (US) deeggaran keessaa kan maddudha. Humnoonni kunis kan hojjetan bakka Israa'el qajeelatti hin to'anne qofa keessattidha.

title: Exclusive: UK told Karim Khan it would not back him as ICC prosecutor before removal vote
english: The UK government informed ICC prosecutor Karim Khan that it would not support him shortly before a member state vote resulted in his removal from office. Despite being cleared of sexual misconduct allegations by an internal panel earlier this year, a majority of ICC member states voted in a secret ballot to dismiss him. Khan had previously been denied a meeting with UK ministers as the pressure surrounding these accusations grew.
amharic: የእንግሊዝ መንግሥት የዓለም አቀፉ የወንጀለኞች ፍርድ ቤት ዋና አቃቤ ህግ ካሪም ካን ከሥራቸው ከመባረራቸው በፊት ድጋፍ እንደማይሰጣቸው አሳውቋቸው ነበር። ምንም እንኳን ቀደም ሲል በነበረው ምርመራ ከወሲባዊ ጥቃት ክስ ነፃ ቢሆኑም፣ አባል ሀገራት በድብቅ ድምፅ በመስጠት ከኃላፊነታቸው እንዲነሱ ወስነዋል። ካሪም ካን ከመባረራቸው በፊት ከእንግሊዝ ሚኒስትሮች ጋር ለመነጋገር ያቀረቡት ጥያቄም ተቀባይነት አላገኘም።
oromo: Mootummaan UK abbaa seeraa mana murtii yakka addunyaa (ICC) Karim Khan irratti kora miseensotaa dura deggarsa akka hin qabne ibseera. Karim Khan yakka saal-qunnamtii irratti dhihaate duraan qulqulluu ta'uun isaanii mirkanaa'us, miseensota ICC keessaa baay'een isaanii sagalee icitiin bakka bu'ummaa isaanii akka gadi lisan murteessaniiru. Kanaan dura, Karim Khan kora kanarratti ministiroota UK waliin wal arguuf gaaffii dhiheessan ture, garuu gaaffiin kun fudhatama hin arganne.

title: Iran foreign minister says Ukraine's attack on Iranian vessel 'cannot go unanswered'
english: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi stated that a recent Ukrainian strike on an Iranian merchant ship, which resulted in a sailor's death, will face a response. Araqchi communicated this position during discussions with European and Russian officials, accusing Ukraine of acting on behalf of Israel to provoke a wider conflict. He condemned the attack as a direct violation of international law and indicated that Iran would not let the incident pass without consequences.
amharic: የኢራን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር አባስ አራቅቺ በቅርቡ በዩክሬን በተሰነዘረ ጥቃት የአንድ መርከበኛ ህይወት ማለፉን ተከትሎ፣ ኢራን አጸፋዊ እርምጃ እንደምትወስድ አስታውቀዋል። ሚኒስትሩ ከአውሮፓ ህብረት እና ከሩሲያ አቻዎቻቸው ጋር ባደረጉት ውይይት፣ ጥቃቱ የተፈጸመው በእስራኤል ትዕዛዝ እንደሆነ በመግለጽ በጥብቅ አውግዘዋል። ይህ ድርጊት የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅትን ቻርተር የሚጥስ እና ጦርነቱን ወደ አውሮፓ ለማስፋፋት የታለመ ነው በማለት ኢራን ዝም እንደማትል አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Iraan Abbas Araqchi dhiheenya kana doonii daldalaa Iraan irratti haleellaa Yukreeniin geggeeffamee fi du'a namoota tokkoo hordofsiise kanaaf deebii akka kennan ibsaniiru. Ministirichi hoggantoota Awurooppaa fi Raashiyaa waliin mari'atan kanaan, haleellaan kun ajaja Israa'el irratti hundaa'uudhaan kan raawwatame fi waraana kana gara Awurooppaa babal'isuuf kan karoorfame ta'uu himaniiru. Iraan haleellaa seera idil-addunyaa cabsu kana akkasumatti kan hin dhiisne ta'uu fi tarkaanfii barbaachisaa kan fudhattu ta'uu ibsaniiru.

title: Senator Whitehouse: Netanyahu a ‘walking provocation’ for Americans
english: US Senator Sheldon Whitehouse has strongly criticized Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, labeling him a provocation to the American public. The senator argued that the US is failing to uphold its global reputation by engaging in dishonest and poorly managed conflicts. Furthermore, he claimed that President Trump is breaking his campaign pledges to stay out of unnecessary wars, particularly regarding the ongoing tensions with Iran.
amharic: የአሜሪካው ሴናተር ሼልደን ዋይትሃውስ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ ለአሜሪካውያን የሚያበሳጭ ሰው እንደሆኑ ገልጸዋል። ሴናተሩ አሜሪካ በኢራን ላይ በምትወስደው የተሳሳተ እና ግልጽነት የጎደለው ጦርነት ምክንያት ዓለም አቀፍ ዝናዋ እየተበላሸ እንደሆነ ተናግረዋል። በተጨማሪም ፕሬዚዳንት ትራምፕ ከጦርነት እራቀለሁ ብለው የገቡትን ቃል እየጣሱ መሆናቸውን በመተቸት አሜሪካ እየሄደችበት ያለው መንገድ አሳሳቢ መሆኑን አስረድተዋል።
oromo: Senator Sheldon Whitehouse kan jedhaman, muummichi ministeeraa Israa'el Benjamin Netanyahu ummata Ameerikaa biratti kan nama aarsan ta'uu ibsaniiru. Senatorichi, Ameerikaan waraana Iran waliin gaggeessaa jirtuun walqabatee gocha dogoggoraa fi soba ta'e raawwachaa waan jirtuuf, maqaan biyyattii addunyaa irratti xiqqaachaa jiraachuu dubbataniiru. Akkasumas, pireezidaantiin Ameerikaa Donald Trump waraana hin barbaachifne keessa hin galle jedhanii waadaa seenan cabsaa jiraachuu isaanis komataniiru.

title: Kashmiris call India's rule settler-colonialism - and we should listen to them
english: Kashmiri writers, journalists, and scholars are increasingly defining India's presence in their region as a form of settler-colonialism rather than just a territorial dispute. By documenting human rights abuses and the realities of military control, they are offering a deeper analysis of the systemic power dynamics at play. This intellectual movement aims to shift the global understanding of the conflict by highlighting the historical and material conditions that sustain Indian rule.
amharic: የካሽሚር ጋዜጠኞችና ምሁራን የህንድን አስተዳደር እንደ ሰፈራ ቅኝ ግዛት (settler-colonialism) በመፈረጅ አዲስ ትንታኔ እያቀረቡ ይገኛሉ። እነዚህ አካላት በክልሉ የሚፈጸሙ የሰብአዊ መብት ጥሰቶችን እና የወታደራዊ ቁጥጥር ውጤቶችን በመመዝገብ፣ ችግሩ ከድንበር ክርክር ያለፈ የስርዓት መዋቅር መሆኑን ለማሳየት እየሞከሩ ነው። ይህ ጥረት የካሽሚርን ግጭት ከታሪካዊና ቁሳዊ ሁኔታዎች አንጻር በመመልከት ዓለም አቀፍ ግንዛቤን ለመቀየር ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Barreessitoonni fi hayyoonni Kaashmiir, bulchiinsa Indiyaa kan naanannoo isaanii keessatti argamu 'kolonii qubsumaa' jechuun ibsuun qorannoo haaraa dhiheessaa jiru. Namoonni kunneen miidhaa mirga namoomaa fi dhiibbaa waraanaa uummata irra gahuu galmeessuun, rakkoon kun walitti buiinsa daangaa qofa osoo hin taane, caaseffama sirnaa ta'uu ibsu. Qorannoon kun rakkoo Kaashmiir haala seenaa fi qabatamaa jiru irratti hundaa'uun hubannoo addunyaa jijjiiruuf kan qophaaye dha.

title: Bahrain, Israel hold talks on Abraham Accords
english: Bahraini King Hamad bin Isa Al Khalifa and Israeli President Isaac Herzog recently held a telephone conversation to discuss regional affairs. President Herzog praised the King for his commitment to the Abraham Accords and his vision for the Middle East. This discussion highlights the ongoing diplomatic engagement between the two nations following their normalization agreement.
amharic: የባህሬኑ ንጉሥ ሃማድ ቢን ኢሳ አል ካሊፋ እና የእስራኤሉ ፕሬዚዳንት አይዛክ ሄርዞግ በስልክ በመነጋገር ስለ ቀጠናው ሁኔታ እና ስለ አብርሃም ስምምነት ተወያይተዋል። ፕሬዚዳንቱ ለንጉሱ ያላቸውን አክብሮት በመግለጽ ለቀጠናው ሰላም ላሳዩት አመራር እና ራዕይ አድናቆታቸውን ችረዋል። ይህ ውይይት ሁለቱ ሀገራት ግንኙነታቸውን ካሻሻሉ በኋላ ያላቸውን ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ትስስር የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Mootichi Baahreen Hamad biin Isaa Al Khaliifaa fi Pireezidaantiin Israa'el Ayizaak Heerzoog dhimmoota naannichaa fi waliigaltee Abrahaam irratti bilbilan mari'ataniiru. Pireezidaantiin Heerzoog mootichaaf geggeessummaa isaanii fi ilaalcha gara fuulduraa kan naannichaa irratti qaban galateeffataniiru. Mariin kun biyyoonni lameen walitti dhufeenya isaanii erga haaromsanii booda walitti dhufeenya diippiloomaasii isaanii cimsachaa akka jiran agarsiisa.

title: In photos: Aftermath of Israeli settler attacks on West Bank mosques
english: Israeli settlers recently carried out attacks against a mosque located in the West Bank village of Qusra. Photos from the scene show significant damage, including parts of the building being burned down. Local residents, including elderly community members, have been left to deal with the destruction of their place of worship.
amharic: በዌስት ባንክ ቁስራ መንደር የሚገኝ መስጊድ በእስራኤል ሰፋሪዎች ጥቃት ደርሶበታል። የተነሱ ፎቶግራፎች እንደሚያሳዩት መስጊዱ በእሳት በመቃጠሉ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት ደርሶበታል። የአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች የአምልኮ ስፍራቸው በመውደሙ ከፍተኛ ሀዘን ላይ ናቸው።
oromo: Godina Lixaa Baankii ganda Qusraa keessatti masjiida tokko irratti weerartoonni Israa'el miidhaa geessisaniiru. Suuraawwan bakka sanaa agarsiisan akka ibsanitti, masjiidichi ibiddan gubatee miidhaa cimaatu irra ga'e. Jiraattonni naannichaa iddoon waaqeffannaa isaanii barbadaa'uun isaanii gadda guddaa keessa isaan galcheera.

title: Exclusive: UK told Karim Khan it would not back him as ICC prosecutor before removal vote
english: The UK government informed Karim Khan that it would not support his continuation as ICC chief prosecutor following sexual misconduct allegations against him. Despite being previously cleared of wrongdoing by a judicial panel, Khan was dismissed by a member-state vote after a review board questioned the nature of his relationships. The UK refused Khan's request to present his side to government ministers before the secret ballot took place.
amharic: የዩናይትድ ኪንግደም መንግስት በካሪም ኻን ላይ በደረሰባቸው የወሲብ ጥቃት ክስ ምክንያት እንደ ዓለም አቀፉ የወንጀለኞች ፍርድ ቤት ዋና አቃቤ ህግ እንደማትደግፋቸው አሳውቃለች። ካሪም ኻን ቀደም ሲል በነጻ ቢለቀቁም፣ የአባል ሀገራት ድምጽ አሰጣጥ ውጤት ከስልጣናቸው እንዲነሱ ተወስኗል። እንግሊዝ፣ ኻን ድምጽ ከመሰጠቱ በፊት ጉዳያቸውን ለመንግስት ባለስልጣናት እንዲያስረዱ ያቀረቡትን ጥያቄ ውድቅ አድርጋለች።
oromo: Mootummaan UK himata miidhaa saalaa isaan irratti dhiyaateen walqabatee, Karim Khan akka abukaatoo olaanaa ICC tti akka hin deeggarre beeksise. Karim Khan duraan komii sana irraa bilisa ta'anii kan turan ta'us, biyyoota miseensa ta'aniin sagalee laatameen aangoo irraa kaafamaniiru. UK, Karim Khan sagaleen kennamuun dura dhimmi isaanii ministeerotaaf akka ibsamu gaaffii dhiyeessan fudhatama dhabsiisteetti.

title: Lando Norris wins Hungarian Grand Prix for first F1 triumph in 2026
english: Lando Norris secured his first Formula One victory of the 2026 season at the Hungarian Grand Prix after benefiting from a collision involving his teammate Oscar Piastri. Max Verstappen finished in second place, while championship leader Kimi Antonelli rounded out the podium in third. This win marks a significant return to form for Norris just before the mid-season break.
amharic: ላንዶ ኖሪስ በሃንጋሪ ግራንድ ፕሪክስ አሸንፎ የ2026 የውድድር ዘመን የመጀመሪያ ድሉን ተቀዳጅቷል። የቡድን አጋሩ ኦስካር ፒያስትሪ በደረሰበት ግጭት ምክንያት ወደ ኋላ በመቅረቱ ኖሪስ ቀዳሚ ለመሆን ችሏል። ማክስ ቨርስታፔን ሁለተኛ ሲወጣ፣ የውድድሩ መሪ ኪሚ አንቶኔሊ ሶስተኛ ደረጃን ይዞ አጠናቋል።
oromo: Lando Norris dorgommii Hungarian Grand Prix injifachuun injifannoo isaa isa jalqabaa bara 2026 galmeesseera. Hiriyyaan isaa garee McLaren, Oscar Piastri, walitti buiinsa isa mudateen boodatti hafuun isaa Norris akka injifatu isa gargaareera. Max Verstappen lammaffaa bahuun, hogganaan sadarkaa dorgommiitii Kimi Antonelli ammoo sadarkaa sadaffaa qabateera.

title: More than 360,000 evacuated as wildfires rage in France and Spain
english: Intense wildfires fueled by record-breaking heatwaves have forced over 360,000 residents to flee their homes across France and Spain. Firefighting efforts are being hampered by a lack of resources and extreme weather conditions, leading to significant destruction of land. Authorities are now calling for greater international support and raising concerns about the long-term impact of climate change on future fire risks.
amharic: በፈረንሳይ እና በስፔን በተከሰቱ ከባድ የእሳት ቃጠሎዎች ሳቢያ ከ360,000 በላይ ሰዎች ከቀያቸው እንዲፈናቀሉ ተገደዋል። በከፍተኛ ሙቀት እና በድርቅ ምክንያት እየተባባሰ የመጣው ይህ አደጋ የነደደውን እሳት ለመቆጣጠር የሰው ኃይልና ግብዓት እጥረት በመኖሩ አስቸጋሪ ሆኗል። አገራቱ የአየር ንብረት ለውጥ ተፅዕኖን ለመቋቋም ዓለም አቀፍ ትብብር እንደሚያስፈልግ እያሳሰቡ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Ho'i garmalee dabaluun ibidda bosonaa Faransaayii fi Ispeen keessatti ka'een namoota 360,000 ol ta'an mana isaanii gadhiisanii akka baqatan dirqisiiseera. Ibidda kana dhaamsuuf humna namaa fi meeshaalee gahaa dhabuun rakkoo guddaa ta'ee jira. Mootummoonni biyyoota lamaanii jijjiiramni qilleensaa rakkoo kana daran hammaachisuu isaa ibsanii, deeggarsa idil-addunyaa gaafataniiru.

title: Israel carries out double tap strike in central Gaza
english: The Israeli military conducted a targeted double-tap airstrike on a vehicle located in the central region of Gaza. According to the local interior ministry, this attack resulted in the deaths of Gaza’s internal security director and another official. A double-tap strike involves a secondary hit following an initial blast, often intended to maximize casualties.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በማዕከላዊ ጋዛ በሚገኝ አንድ ተሽከርካሪ ላይ ተከታታይ የአየር ጥቃት ፈጽመዋል። የጋዛ የውስጥ ጉዳይ ሚኒስቴር እንደገለጸው፣ በዚህ ጥቃት የጋዛ የውስጥ ደህንነት ኃላፊ እና አንድ ሌላ ባለስልጣን ተገድለዋል። ድርብ ጥቃት ተብሎ የሚጠራው ይህ ድርጊት፣ የመጀመሪያው ጥቃት ከተፈጸመ በኋላ በቦታው የሚደርሱ ሰዎችን ለማጥቃት በድጋሚ የሚደረግ የቦምብ ድብደባ ነው።
oromo: Waraanni Israa'el konkolaataa naannoo Giza giddugaleessaatti argamu irratti haleellaa qilleensa irraa lama walitti aansuun raawwateera. Ministeerri dhimma keessaa Giza akka ibsetti, haleellaa kanaan hogganaan nageenya keessaa Giza fi qondaalli tokko ajjeefamaniiru. Haleellaan 'double tap' jedhamu kun haleellaa jalqabaa booda warra gargaarsaaf ykn ilaaluuf dhufan irratti haleellaa lammaffaa raawwachuu kan of keessatti qabatuudha.

title: Tunisia grapples with five years of crisis since Saied’s power grab
english: Tunisia is facing significant political and economic instability five years after President Kais Saied took control and suspended parliament. While some supporters believe his actions were necessary for national reform, critics argue that his rule has led to the collapse of state institutions and a dangerous concentration of power. The country is now suffering from declining investments, high unemployment, and severe food inflation, which has caused many citizens to struggle and look for opportunities abroad.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ካይስ ሰይድ ስልጣኑን ከተቆጣጠሩ እና ፓርላማውን ካገዱ አምስት ዓመታት በኋላ ቱኒዚያ ከባድ የፖለቲካ እና የኢኮኖሚ ቀውስ ውስጥ ትገኛለች። አንዳንድ ደጋፊዎች የፕሬዝዳንቱ እርምጃ ለሀገሪቱ ማሻሻያ አስፈላጊ እንደሆነ ቢከራከሩም፣ ተቃዋሚዎች ግን ስልጣን በአንድ እጅ መከማቸቱ የመንግስት ተቋማትን እያዳከመ እንደሆነ ይገልጻሉ። አሁን ባለው የኢኮኖሚ ውድቀት፣ የሥራ አጥነት መጨመር እና የኑሮ ውድነት ምክንያት ብዙ ዜጎች ለከፍተኛ ችግር የተጋለጡ ሲሆን፣ መፍትሄ ፍለጋም ወደ ውጭ አገራት ለመሰደድ እየተገደዱ ነው።
oromo: Pirezidanti Kais Saied aangoo erga qabatanii fi mana maree erga dhaabanii waggaa shan booda, Tuniziyaan rakkoo siyaasaa fi dinagdee cimaa keessa jirti. Deggartoonni tokko tarkaanfiin kun biyyattii oolchuuf barbaachisaa ture jedhanii amananis, mormitoonni garuu aangoon hundi harka isa tokkotti kuufamuun isaa bu'uura mootummaa akka laaffise dubbatu. Yeroo ammaa dinagdeen gadi bu'uu, hojii dhabdoonni dabaluu fi gatiin nyaataa ol ka'uu irraa kan ka'e lammiileen hedduun rakkachaa jiru; kunis namoonni hedduun carraa gaarii barbaacha biyyaa akka baqatan isaan dirqisiiseera.

title: Senegal’s Faye launches a new party, formalising his split with Sonko
english: Senegalese President Bassirou Diomaye Faye has officially launched his own political party, Kiiraay, signaling a definitive end to his partnership with Prime Minister Ousmane Sonko. This move marks a major shift in the nation's political landscape, as the two leaders, who once worked together to win the 2024 election, are now competing for influence over the country's reform movement. Faye stated that his new party aims to focus on institutional transparency and public service rather than personal politics.
amharic: የሴኔጋሉ ፕሬዚዳንት ባሲሩ ዲዮማዬ ፋዬ፣ ከጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ኦስማን ሶንኮ ጋር የነበራቸውን የፖለቲካ ትብብር ማብቃቱን በማወጅ 'ኪራይ' የተባለ አዲስ የፖለቲካ ፓርቲ መስርተዋል። ይህ እርምጃ በ2024 ምርጫ አብረው ተሰልፈው ስልጣን ላይ የወጡትን ሁለቱ መሪዎች መካከል ያለውን ልዩነት በይፋ የሚያሳይ ነው። ፕሬዚዳንቱ አዲሱ ፓርቲያቸው በግለሰቦች ሳይሆን በተቋማት ግልጽነት እና በህዝብ አገልግሎት ላይ የተመሰረተ እንደሚሆን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Senegaal Baasiiruu Diyomaaye Faaye, tumsa isaan muummicha ministeeraa Usmaan Sonkoo waliin qaban xumuruun paartii siyaasaa haaraa 'Kiiraay' jedhamu hundeffataniiru. Tarkaanfin kun gaaffii siyaasaa biyyattii keessatti jijjiirama guddaa fiduu danda'a; sababiinsaas waggaa 2024tti waliin ta'anii mootummaa kan ijaaran geggeessitoonni kun amma of danda'anii socho'aa jiru. Pirezidaantiin akka jedhanitti, paartiin kun fedhii dhuunfaa irra, iftoominaa fi tajaajila ummataa irratti kan xiyyeeffatu ta'a.

title: Pope Leo calls to ‘suspend the attacks’ and return to dialogue
english: Pope Leo XIV has urged an immediate halt to the worsening conflict in the Middle East, highlighting the severe toll on civilians in Gaza and the West Bank. He noted that military actions have caused widespread destruction and critical shortages of basic necessities like water and power. The Pope is calling for all sides to stop fighting and return to diplomatic talks to establish a fair and lasting political resolution.
amharic: ርዕሰ ሊቃነ ጳጳሳት ሊዮ አሥራ አራተኛ በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ እየተባባሰ የመጣው ግጭት በአስቸኳይ እንዲቆም ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። በጋዛ እና በምዕራብ ባንክ ለሚገኙ ንጹሐን ዜጎች እየደረሰ ያለውን ጉዳት እና የውሃና የኤሌክትሪክ አቅርቦት መስተጓጎል በስጋት እንደሚያዩ ገልጸዋል። ግጭቱን በማቆም በዲፕሎማሲያዊ መንገድ ፍትሃዊ እና ዘላቂ መፍትሄ እንዲፈለግም አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Papaa Liyoo kudha afurreeffataan (XIV) walitti bu’iinsa Baha Giddu galeessa keessatti hammaataa jiru akka dhaabbatu waamicha dhiyeessaniiru. Waraanni kun jiraattota Gaazaa fi Beenqaa Dhihaa miidhuu akkasumas hanqina bishaanii fi ibsaa akka hammaatu taasiseera jedhan. Papaan kun gareewwan wal waraanaa jiran haleellaa dhaabanii marii nageenyaa jalqabuun furmaata siyaasaa haqa qabeessa ta’e akka barbaadan gaafataniiru.
